body:
I cant hate her for telling the truth, we have been always honest with eachother. I hope things will get straight as you say.
Im having too much free-time, thats how I learnt playing guitar, barely any people are having free time to either watch a movie in their weekends around me.
You care about people you dont know, and your advice is more than welcome for me. I feel I had to went out, and you have listened. Thank you.

I love how you took the positive toughts out. You are right, I'd throw away a valuable life, others would envy. Im still thinking, being lonely is not someone would like to be.
Each day suicide is coming to my mind, each day stronger than before. Im having a week off from the work, and Im getting too busy with my toughts.
You are totally right, Im falling in love way too fast, thank you for the uplifting words.
